description: Capture Gambit progress and all nineteen native reward states on the regular save. Native reward values include activation flags; static record names retain composite reward amounts.

extractions.label: run_times
extractions.description: Six best run times in seconds, including saved fractional seconds.

extractions.label: total_time
extractions.description: Total Gambit time from all six saved run times, in seconds.

extractions.label: base_points
extractions.description: Native sum of challenge scores before the account multiplier.

extractions.label: final_points
extractions.description: Final native Gambit points after the account multiplier.

extractions.label: doublers_total
extractions.description: Total Summoning Doubler capacity from Gambit and the Summoning Star.

extractions.label: doublers_available
extractions.description: Native available Summoning Doublers. This getter only changes a transient scratch counter.

extractions.label: reward_effects
extractions.description: Every native active reward value. Rewards 9, 10, 12, 13 and future placeholders return flags, not complete composite magnitudes.

extractions.label: reward_unlocked
extractions.description: All reward score-unlock states. Native effect getters also suppress effects in Tutorial scenes.

extractions.label: reward_multipliers
extractions.description: Essence, coin, clicker and Ninja Stealth effect multipliers, calculated as 1 plus the native percentage bonus divided by 100. Do not apply the native description's display-only floor.

extractions.label: next_opal_score
extractions.description: Next whole-point target for an unclaimed Gambit Opal. This applies the source award rule and the game's rounded logarithm constant to the saved found count.

extractions.label: opals_found
extractions.description: Saved Gambit cavern Opals credited to the account ledger.
